record.question: The chemical constituent of aloe vera which gives the soothing effect is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Acemannan polysaccharide. Acemannan, an aloe-derived acetylated polysaccharide, is associated with soothing and wound-healing effects. Source/context note: Evidence about soothing effects varies by preparation and clinical indication. Reference: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2763764/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
